{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the clean worked
print(f"First few cleaned revenue values: {df['revenue_clean'].head().tolist()}")

# Check for QA orders with 999999.99
print(f"Number of rows with revenue_clean == 999999.99: {df['revenue_clean'].eq(999999.99).sum()}")"}
